CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSCurrencyFormat

Returns a currency amount formatted with the conventions of the current locale: currency symbol, thousands separators and two decimal places.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSCurrencyFormat(number [, type ])

Parameters

number
The amount to format.
type
Optional. local (the default) uses the local currency symbol, for example "$1,234.50"; international uses the three-letter currency code, for example "USD1,234.50"; none leaves the symbol out, for example "1,234.50".

Returns

The formatted amount as a string. Negative amounts are shown in parentheses in the local format and with a minus sign in the other two.

Usage

In the English (US) locale (the only one KoldFusion for UNIX formats with, see SetLocale), the local format is the same as DollarFormat. Use LSParseCurrency to turn the result back into a number and LSEuroCurrencyFormat for euro amounts.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Amounts = "1234.5,-99.95,1000000">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Amount</TH><TH>local</TH><TH>international</TH><TH>none</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="A" LIST="#Amounts#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#A#</TD>
    <TD ALIGN="right">#LSCurrencyFormat(A)#</TD>
    <TD ALIGN="right">#LSCurrencyFormat(A, "international")#</TD>
    <TD ALIGN="right">#LSCurrencyFormat(A, "none")#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
